items.title: Quantum computer development is more about national security than profits, says expert
items.summary: Japanese electronics giant NEC stopped development of gate-based superconducting quantum computer hardware at the end of March 2026. The decision also reportedly prompted quantum R&D researchers to join Fujitsu.
